stack.nuxt_ui: transitive only (no direct apps/web dependency; @UTable/@UCard/@UButton etc. used, arrives via narduk-nuxt-template-layer-core)
stack.tanstack_table: none direct (UTable wraps it internally, but no v-model:sorting/pagination/global-filter or getXRowModel wired anywhere)

local_reimplementations.name: useHarmonyData (single-blob client data layer)
local_reimplementations.notes: One useFetch('/api/harmony?scope=admin|public') returns the WHOLE dataset (leads, orders, retailers, SKUs, site content); every admin table/list derives its view from this single client blob with no server-side limit/offset/cursor anywhere. Architecturally the opposite of pacc-trac's usePagedList -- fine at current business scale, but the pattern that would need to change first if a shared paginated table is adopted here.

local_reimplementations.name: AdminStatusBadge
local_reimplementations.notes: Only ONE status-badge component in this repo (contrast with pacc-trac's 9). Reasonable existing local convergence narduk-libs' chip could absorb directly.

table.mobile: none (wrapped in plain overflow-hidden, no min-width, no scroll fallback -- inferred risk, not a proven bug)
table.notes: UTable given only :data and :columns -- no v-model:sorting/pagination/global-filter, no getPaginationRowModel/getSortedRowModel. Purely a styled static render.
v-if="filteredRows.length" guards an implicit empty state (no dedicated empty component).

table.server_api: none directly -- rows come from useHarmonyData()'s single client-side fetch
table.notes: Full-dump from the one big harmony-data blob, no pagination at any layer.

table.server_api: none (client-side xlsx parse via the 'xlsx' package)
table.notes: Import preview grid for spreadsheet-uploaded SKU data.

confirm_modal.notes: No shared ConfirmModal wrapper found; direct Nuxt UI usage.

toast_notify.notes: Direct Nuxt UI composable, not a reinvention.

kpi_stat_tile.notes: No consumer found by static <Tag> grep (incl. Nuxt directory-prefix variants) -- likely resolved dynamically (a section-type registry / <component :is>) rather than dead; not confirmed either way under this budget.

Same caveat as PublicStatsSection -- this repo's public site is built from an admin-editable 'sections' system, so most section components are likely wired through a type registry, not a literal template tag.

date_time_format.notes: Seen imported by leads/index.vue and orders/index.vue; not read in full or counted app-wide.

lightbox_media.notes: Uses narduk-core's AppLightbox directly (line 466) -- the only narduk-libs (non-legacy-layer) component tag found anywhere in this repo.

auth_gating_ui.notes: definePageMeta({ middleware: ['admin'] }) seen on admin pages; auth UI itself comes from the legacy auth layer package, not hand-rolled locally -- not a reinvention finding.

chart_wrapper.notes: Diagram rendering (mermaid), not a data chart -- different category than narduk-charts; flagged only for completeness.

file_upload.notes: Backed by app/composables/useImageUpload.ts and the narduk-nuxt-template-layer-uploads package. Real, multi-consumer file-upload UI -- a genuine file_upload extraction candidate given narduk-libs ships none.

other.notes: Spreadsheet (.xlsx) bulk-import UI for SKU data -- a pattern none of the other two L4 repos have.

defect_history.summary: Migrate Harmony onto narduk-libs and remove Command control-plane dependency -- the original tracker that tprinvest#50 cites as 'the proven downstream migration pattern' to follow. Body: app still depends on legacy narduk-nuxt-template-layer-* packages and narduk-platform; done-when includes replacing them with the supported narduk-libs package set.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Wire real sort/paginate/search onto the existing UTable usages
top_extraction_candidates.why: This app already reaches for Nuxt UI's UTable (the 'correct' primitive) in all 5 of its table surfaces, yet none of the 4 list-style ones use any sort/paginate/filter row-model at all -- same behavioral gap as pacc-trac and tprinvest despite different starting tech. A shared narduk-libs DataTable that wraps UTable with sort/paginate/search pre-wired would fix this with a drop-in swap, not a rewrite.

top_extraction_candidates.name: FileUpload / ImageUpload
top_extraction_candidates.why: 7 real consumers, narduk-libs ships no file/image upload component today; this plus narduk-nuxt-template-layer-uploads' plumbing is reasonable prior art.

top_extraction_candidates.name: StatusChip (promote AdminStatusBadge)
top_extraction_candidates.why: Only one local badge implementation (unlike pacc-trac's 9) -- low-risk to converge across the estate since there's nothing to reconcile within this repo itself.

notes: Second-lowest pattern density of the three L4 repos but still a real operational app (leads/orders/retailers/SKU/site-content admin for a boutique hot-sauce brand), unlike tprinvest's static archive. Legacy template-layer app (auth+uploads+analytics+seo+core+testing, all ^1.18.x), one incidental narduk-core AppLightbox usage otherwise zero non-legacy narduk-libs adoption. Whole data layer is a single client-fetched blob (useHarmonyData, 22 consumers) with zero server-side pagination anywhere -- architecturally the opposite end of the spectrum from pacc-trac's usePagedList system. harmony-hot-sauce#87 is the ORIGINAL narduk-libs migration tracker that tprinvest#50 explicitly names as the pattern to follow -- both L4 repos point at the same open estate-wide effort (company-hq D-WEBFOUND-2 / company-hq#629 / narduk-libs#76 per tprinvest#50's body).
